question: Who among the following travellers came to India from Uzbekistan in the 11th century?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Al-Biruni**__.

__
 
• **Al-Biruni is a traveller who came to India from Uzbekistan in the 11th century**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Al-Biruni was a Khwarazmian Iranian scholar and polymath during the Islamic golden age.
 
• He is well versed in physics, mathematics, astronomy, natural science.
 
• *Work*: Kitab-al-Tafhim.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
 

 **Name**
 **Details**
 
 

 Abdur Razzaq Samarquandi
 
 
 
• He is an Islamic scholar and Persian Timurid, chronicler.
 
• As an ambassador he visited Kozhikode, western India in the early 1440s.
 
 
 
 

 Ibn Battuta
 
 
 
• He was an Arab scholar. He was from Morocco.
 
• He reached the royal courts of Mohammad Bin Tughlaq
 
 
 
 

 Francois Bernier
 
 
 
• He was a French physician, philosopher and traveller.
 
• He lived in India for 12 years.
 
• He was associated with the Mughal court as a personal physician of Dara Shikoh
